og9og905.dialogue: Yes, we talk-talk, I tell you things, you tell me things. First, you tell me - did you kill mage? Crack his bones, squish his head?
og9og905.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og906.dialogue: Oho, you try, kill us - if you can. But fear - I laugh! Gubuks fear! Orogs not fear, nothing, ever!
og9og906.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og907.dialogue: But orogs not stupid - I not stupid. Why fight? Why not talk?
og9og907.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og908.dialogue: Not matter? You stupid. Orogs swore to protect mage. So if mage alive, orog honor say, attack, kill, protect mage. So, you kill mage, or not?
og9og908.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og909.dialogue: Uh - uh - uh- that is bad. Because orogs swore to protect mage. So if mage alive, orog honor say, attack.
og9og909.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og911.dialogue: Uh - uh - uh- that is good. Because orogs swore to protect mage. But if mage dead, orog honor say, nothing to protect, no need to kill you gubuks.
og9og911.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og912.dialogue: If mage dead, then orog honor say, no need to kill you gubuks.
og9og912.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og913.dialogue: So now I tell you something. You ask, ask me.
og9og913.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og915.dialogue: They put a gubuk in a cage. Small gubuk they call 'Nottle' - Garbage-man. Live in wagon, yes.
og9og915.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og916.dialogue: They take him out of wagon and down into dungeon. Ask, ask, ask him things. Oho, Garbage-man not like cage! He talk and talk.
og9og916.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og917.dialogue: Hai, keep going up stairs, up many stairs, you will find it. Duluk! Beware! Mages are there, with many orogs.
og9og917.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og918.dialogue: That is key to cage, cage down in dungeon, way way down.
og9og918.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og919.dialogue: Dwarf-key, Dum-a-thone, Room of Dum-a-thone, yes.
og9og919.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og920.dialogue: Oh yes, orogs never go there, but mages talk. Mages talk, say 'Mistress want this - Mistress want that - yes, Mistress, oh yes Mistress...'
og9og920.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og921.dialogue: Mages make deal with orogs. Orogs walk dungeons, yes, find magic items. Then mages give orogs great thing, yes, very great...
og9og921.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og922.dialogue: ...but I no tell you more about that. No, no more.
og9og922.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og201.dialogue: Mistress! Paggh on Kya Mistress! Shar is the only, the Mistress of Pain.
og9og201.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og202.dialogue: I will teach you who is Mistress.
og9og202.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og204.dialogue: Lady Shar! Lady of Loss! Singer of Eternal Night!
og9og204.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og205.dialogue: She beautiful! I know, I see her! She touch me!
og9og205.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og206.dialogue: She walk by, cloak feather - touch my hand. Here! Right here! Burning, burning...
og9og206.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og207.dialogue: Now I walk in Shar darkness, pain and loss and no forgetting!
og9og207.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og208.dialogue: Fear nothing! For Shar makes me strong always.
og9og208.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og209.dialogue: Now I walk in Shar darkness, pain and loss and...
og9og209.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og928.dialogue: Ugbuz! Shut up! You say this thing again, again, again. Shut up!
og9og928.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og929.dialogue: Hey, hai, now we talk again, you soft-skins...
og9og929.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og211.dialogue: You leave now! Or I call Lady Shar!
og9og211.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og212.dialogue: She aid me, yes, her loyal servant. Shar touch you, touch like feather, you all die.
og9og212.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og213.dialogue: No! You leave! You leave now! Or I call Lady Shar!
og9og213.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og214.dialogue: She aid me, yes, her loyal servant. Shar touch you, touch like feather, you all die.
og9og214.speaker: Orggrd2

og9og935.dialogue: Shar is goddess, very old goddess of night, Lady of Loss and Pain.
og9og935.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og936.dialogue: Shar crush hope, blot out light, bring loss, no forgetting.
og9og936.speaker: Orggrd1

og9og215.dialogue: Shar touch me! Not forget, never forget I chosen by the Lady.
og9og215.speaker: Orggrd2

og9pro00.speaker: Protagonist

og9pro01.speaker: Protagonist

og9pro12.speaker: Protagonist

og1ogc02.dialogue: It is them. Speak as I told you! Speak!
og1ogc02.speaker: Orgchief

og1ogs00.dialogue: Ah, my chief says, you parley with us, unless you stupid fools, and then you die.
og1ogs00.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs01.dialogue: Ah, my chief likes you, you not soft.
og1ogs01.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs02.dialogue: Now, my chief says, we attack stupid Cult fools together, yes? And claim great Helm Cleaver.
og1ogs02.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs03.dialogue: Simple, heh. Cult hired orog to guard doors where great Helm Cleaver is kept.
og1ogs03.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs04.dialogue: But clever orog learned how to open doors. Yes, we know Dragon Word, yes yes!
og1ogs04.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs05.dialogue: You go in one door. We go in other. The squishy-soft Cult caught in middle, ha ha!
og1ogs05.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs06.dialogue: It is weapon of victory! The chief of Helm Cleaver rules over all other chiefs.
og1ogs06.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs07.dialogue: Mistress promised it to us, if we help clear dungeon. But maybe she not give! Maybe we must take.
og1ogs07.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs08.dialogue: Cult all bow and scrape, they squishy-soft. She not soft, no no.
og1ogs08.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs09.dialogue: But she not think of us, eh? No, she think far away, she not see us, too late ha ha!
og1ogs09.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs10.dialogue: Ah - ah - ah. So you want Helm Cleaver also! Ha ha, my chief likes that. You not soft-skin! You not squishy! You orog!
og1ogs10.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs11.dialogue: If together squish Cult, then we duel for Helm Cleaver, yes? Your champion, our champion - strongest takes Helm Cleaver.
og1ogs11.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs12.dialogue: You must agree to help attack Cult. Then we tell you, yes!
og1ogs12.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs13.dialogue: Yes, yes, we split skulls together! Now here is what you must do.
og1ogs13.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs14.dialogue: Find door, mark of Dragon Claw on it, yes? In dungeons below, in Halls of Light, orogs guarding it, yes.
og1ogs14.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs15.dialogue: Speak to orogs - tell them you ready. They speak Word, door opens, yes.
og1ogs15.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs16.dialogue: Then - charge in - attack Cult! When you do, we charge from other side.
og1ogs16.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs17.dialogue: Then Helm Cleaver be ours, orog honor served! Gaaash Ghagorbad!
og1ogs17.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs18.dialogue: At door marked with Dragon Claw! Be quick!
og1ogs18.speaker: Orgspoke

og1ogs19.dialogue: Uh, uh, my chief not hear you, you did not say that. Speak again.
og1ogs19.speaker: Orgspoke

og1pro00.speaker: Protagonist

og1pro01.speaker: Protagonist

og2ogg03.dialogue: Soft-skins! Speak at us, or we kill you, because you are stupid.
og2ogg03.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg05.dialogue: Ah, ah, that is good, you not so soft as you look.
og2ogg05.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg06.dialogue: Join us. We attack Cult swine together. And claim the great Helm Cleaver!
og2ogg06.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg07.dialogue: You go through this door and attack. Orog go through other door and attack. Squishy-soft Cult caught in the middle, attack attack, squish squish!
og2ogg07.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg11.dialogue: It is weapon of victory! The chief of the Helm Cleaver rules all other chiefs.
og2ogg11.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg12.dialogue: The Mistress promised it to us, if we help clear dungeon. But maybe she not give! Maybe we must take.
og2ogg12.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg13.dialogue: Cult swine all bow and scrape to her, they squishy-soft. She not soft, no no.
og2ogg13.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg14.dialogue: But she not think of us, eh? No, she think far away, far far away, she not see us until too late.
og2ogg14.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg15.dialogue: Ah - ah - ah. So you want Helm Cleaver also! Ha ha, I like that. You are not soft-skin! You not squishy! You are orog!
og2ogg15.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg16.dialogue: If together squish Cult, then we duel for Helm Cleaver, yes? Your champion, our champion - stronger takes Helm Cleaver.
og2ogg16.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg17.dialogue: You must agree to help us attack Cult. Then we tell you.
og2ogg17.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg18.dialogue: Good, good! We split skulls together!
og2ogg18.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg20.dialogue: Now here is what you must do.
og2ogg20.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg21.dialogue: This door leads to where Cult holds the Helm Cleaver. Our tribe waits at the other door.
og2ogg21.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg22.dialogue: Open this door and attack! We will attack from our side.
og2ogg22.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg23.dialogue: Then the Helm Cleaver will be ours, and orog honor served! Gaaash Ghagorbad!
og2ogg23.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg25.dialogue: Here! I teach you Dragon Word.
og2ogg25.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg26.dialogue: Good! Here! I teach you Dragon Word.
og2ogg26.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg27.dialogue: Uh, uh, I did not hear you, you did not say that. Speak again.
og2ogg27.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg34.dialogue: Soft-skins! You killed our kin! But now, help us crush Cult and win the Helm Cleaver, and we forget your mistake.
og2ogg34.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg35.dialogue: Wait, soft-skins! Stand and wait! Or treasure will slip from your fist.
og2ogg35.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg36.dialogue: Beyond this door, many many Cult swine, guarding treasure. Many jewels, yes. Great weapons, yes. Ghagorbad, the Helm Cleaver, beloved of orog!
og2ogg36.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg38.dialogue: Open this door and attack! We attack also, through other door. Then Cult swine be dead and treasure be ours.
og2ogg38.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg39.dialogue: Will you do this? Give us answer!
og2ogg39.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg40.dialogue: Ah, aha! You are come! You know what to do?
og2ogg40.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg41.dialogue: Two doors lead to the Helm Cleaver. This door and another. Our tribe waits by other door.
og2ogg41.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg42.dialogue: Open this door and attack! We attack from other side. Cult will be crushed between us! Together we will win the Helm Cleaver.
og2ogg42.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg43.dialogue: Aha, many enemies, bubuk and magic-flingers. Too many for you! Too many for us! But together, squeeze Cult swine, split their skulls, aha.
og2ogg43.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2ogg45.dialogue: Wait! Only one thing more. You must learn the Word! Here, I teach you Dragon Word.
og2ogg45.speaker: Oroggrnt

og2dmaYD.dialogue: The orog flares his nostrils, and the secret Word he knows speaks itself.
og2dmaYD.speaker: dm

og2oggYE.dialogue: Word opens this door, Door of Claw! Then attack, attack the Cult!
og2oggYE.speaker: Oroggrnt

og3ogb02.dialogue: Soft-skins! You have done our work! Killed the Cult fools, ha.
og3ogb02.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb03.dialogue: Now you think: 'kill orogs.' First, think this: the Cult may be back.
og3ogb03.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb04.dialogue: We know you, you not squishy. You too want Ghagorbad, great Helm Cleaver.
og3ogb04.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb05.dialogue: Orog honor say, one fights one for Helm Cleaver. A duel, yes.
og3ogb05.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb06.dialogue: Orogs do not care about treasure. We come for Ghagorbad, yes, the great Helm Cleaver.
og3ogb06.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb07.dialogue: Ah! You soft. And now you pay for orogs you have killed.
og3ogb07.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb08.dialogue: Ghagorbad! It is the weapon of victory!
og3ogb08.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb09.dialogue: The chief of Helm Cleaver rules the orogs! All other chiefs bow down, yes.
og3ogb09.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb10.dialogue: The Mistress promised it to me, if orogs help clear dungeon. But maybe she not give! So we take.
og3ogb10.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb11.dialogue: Mistress, Cult Mistress, bah, she is nothing, she cheat orogs.
og3ogb11.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb12.dialogue: Ah - ah - good. You not squishy! You have orog honor!
og3ogb12.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb13.dialogue: Orog honor say, you have one champion, send champion into room to the south. If you leave room, you have lost.
og3ogb13.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb14.dialogue: Orog honor say, no one helps champion.
og3ogb14.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb16.dialogue: Pick your champion! Go south to meet our champion! We duel.
og3ogb16.speaker: Orgboss

og3dma00.dialogue: The first character to enter the room will fight a duel with the Orog champion.
og3dma00.speaker: DM

og3ogb21.dialogue: Soft-skins! You killed my kin! There is no orog honor in you.
og3ogb21.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb22.dialogue: Ah, then they deserved to die, killed by soft-skins, pah!
og3ogb22.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb23.dialogue: But you will not find us so soft.
og3ogb23.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb25.dialogue: No, you not soft. But you tired, and wounded maybe. And we are not!
og3ogb25.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb26.dialogue: That is why you talk talk talk.
og3ogb26.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb29.dialogue: Cult, yes, and you with them.
og3ogb29.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb30.dialogue: We not speak with dishonorable ones. We kill them.
og3ogb30.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb31.dialogue: You say 'sorry' - what I hear is, you are weak.
og3ogb31.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb32.dialogue: We not duel with dishonorable ones. We kill them.
og3ogb32.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb33.dialogue: You say 'let us share' - what I hear is, you are weak.
og3ogb33.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb35.dialogue: Orog honor say, settle it with duel of champions.
og3ogb35.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb36.dialogue: Our champion waits in room to south. You send one champion into room. If you leave room, you have lost.
og3ogb36.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb37.dialogue: Orog honor say, no one helps champion. Winner takes treasure.
og3ogb37.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb40.dialogue: Soft-skins! You fight with honor, and so, Cult is dead, their skulls are split, their treasure is ours, aha!
og3ogb40.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb41.dialogue: We take one prize - Ghagorbad, the Helm Cleaver. You take all but Helm Cleaver. You agree, yes?
og3ogb41.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb42.dialogue: It is weapon of orogs. It is nothing to you.
og3ogb42.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb43.dialogue: Cult has many treasures, take them! Or you are a fool.
og3ogb43.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb44.dialogue: Soft-skins! Remember orog honor! We not want to kill you, but we will.
og3ogb44.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb45.dialogue: Here, we offer this. We take one prize only - Ghagorbad, the Helm Cleaver. All other treasure is yours. You agree, yes?
og3ogb45.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb46.dialogue: Aha, soft-skins! You split Cult skulls, you have orog honor, yes.
og3ogb46.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb47.dialogue: Now orog honor say, we duel for Helm Cleaver. Duel of champions, yes.
og3ogb47.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb48.dialogue: It is weapon of orogs. In your hands, it is axe, nothing more.
og3ogb48.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb50.dialogue: You have one champion, we have one champion. Champions only come into circle. If you leave circle, you lose, yes.
og3ogb50.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb51.dialogue: Orog honor say, no one helps champion.
og3ogb51.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb52.dialogue: Orog honor say, no magic until duel begins. Winner takes all treasure. Winner takes Helm Cleaver!
og3ogb52.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb54.dialogue: Yes! You not squishy-soft! You are orog!
og3ogb54.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb55.dialogue: Your champion meet our champion! It is orog honor.
og3ogb55.speaker: Orgboss

og3ogb56.dialogue: If your champion die, or run away, you have lost. Helm Cleaver ours, ha ha.
og3ogb56.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb02.dialogue: Soft-skins! Your champion was brave, but weak. Our champion has won!
og4ogb02.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb03.dialogue: You have orog honor! We salute you.
og4ogb03.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb04.dialogue: Now we claim Helm Cleaver, as we agreed.
og4ogb04.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb05.dialogue: Soft-skins! Your champion has left the circle! You have lost the duel.
og4ogb05.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb06.dialogue: Now we claim Helm Cleaver, as we agreed. The weapon of victory is ours!
og4ogb06.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb08.dialogue: You fought well. You have orog honor! Helm Cleaver is yours, as we agreed.
og4ogb08.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb10.dialogue: They are beneath the great fortress, the elf-castle.
og4ogb10.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb11.dialogue: They take our kin there, but our kin never return.
og4ogb11.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb13.dialogue: No. We rip Helm Cleaver away from Cult, that is enough.
og4ogb13.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb14.dialogue: Now it is yours - keep it well! Do not let the Dark Mistress have it again! Feed it to the Great Fire, or cast it into the deep, instead.
og4ogb14.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb16.dialogue: We met a naga, he talked of treasures, yes. He said...
og4ogb16.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb17.dialogue: ...treasures heaped, yes, up to knees in bone room of Demon Rivener.
og4ogb17.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb18.dialogue: ...there is much treasure, old treasure, dwarves hide it in the House of Gems.
og4ogb18.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb19.dialogue: ...lizard-men hold a great treasure, in the muck-muck southeast of here.
og4ogb19.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb20.dialogue: ...ormyrrs stole his magic gem, and took it away to the southwest.
og4ogb20.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb21.dialogue: ...most treasure buried long ago, in graves dug by demons in catacombs under the elf-castle.
og4ogb21.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb23.dialogue: Yes! Yes, we take great Helm Cleaver, soft-skins. But orog honor say, we also give.
og4ogb23.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb24.dialogue: Hulimanuk! That is, good hunting to you, friend of orogs.
og4ogb24.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb26.dialogue: It is a sign from Garagos! The Reaver seeks more blood!
og4ogb26.speaker: Orgboss

og4ogb27.dialogue: It is a sign from Garagos! The Reaver is displeased!
og4ogb27.speaker: Orgboss

og4pro01.dialogue: Ask them to join you against the Cult
og4pro01.speaker: Protagonist

og4pro02.dialogue: Ask them where treasure can be found
og4pro02.speaker: Protagonist

og4pro03.dialogue: Tell them to keep the Helm Cleaver
og4pro03.speaker: Protagonist

og4pro04.dialogue: Bid them give you the Helm Cleaver
og4pro04.speaker: Protagonist

or5flm03.dialogue: Hulu, leg-walkers! Dust, dust of many places upon you, yes, and blood of many creatures, yes yes.
or5flm03.speaker: Flem

or5flm04.dialogue: Tell me, where you been? Where you going? Tell, tell this to Flem.
or5flm04.speaker: Flem

or5flm05.dialogue: You return, leg-walkers! Tell me places, yes, places you been.
or5flm05.speaker: Flem
or5flm05.desc: spoken, happy to see you again

or5flm06.dialogue: Oh, olu, leg-walkers, what is this? I smell sadness on you, yes, bad tidings for Ormyrrs. Tell me where you come from.
or5flm06.speaker: Flem

or5flm07.dialogue: Welcome, leg-walking ones! Ormyrrs tell me they see you, yes, you travel far and wide.
or5flm07.speaker: Flem

or5flm08.dialogue: Leg-walkers! You reek of death. Tell to me, yes, tell to me where you have been.
or5flm08.speaker: Flem

or5flm09.dialogue: So - leg-walkers return, talk again with Flem. Why? Where you been, leg-walkers? Where you go?
or5flm09.speaker: Flem

or5flm10.dialogue: Leg-walkers! Ormyrrs travel far, down holes, Ormyrrs learn much, yes. Tell us where you been, I tell you story, yes.
or5flm10.speaker: Flem

or5flm13.dialogue: Leg-walkers! Ormyrrs see you walk, yes, you walk bad under ground. Tell me where you go.
or5flm13.speaker: Flem

or5flm14.dialogue: Hulu! I smell strange dirt on you, yes, dust of ages. Where you been, yes, where you get this dust?
or5flm14.speaker: Flem

or5flm15.dialogue: Nolo, leg-walkers, leg-walking ones. We not like, not like stories we hear, no. Trouble, you stir up trouble, where you go to stir up trouble?
or5flm15.speaker: Flem

or5flm16.dialogue: Leg-walkers! Bad ones, you kill bad ones, Ormyrrs happy that you kill bad ones in place you go.
or5flm16.speaker: Flem

or5flm17.dialogue: Hulu, you come back, you back from that place, yes, I tell you about that place.
or5flm17.speaker: Flem

or5flm20.dialogue: Leg-people! You go down, yes, Ormyrrs see you go down to the big stone place. Tell me where you go.
or5flm20.speaker: Flem

or5flm21.dialogue: Hulu, the bad ones, yes, the bad ones try to find you. Tell Ormyrrs where you been - Ormyrrs stop the bad ones, yes yes!
or5flm21.speaker: Flem

or5flm22.dialogue: Hulu, bad ones, bad ones look all places for leg-walking friends.
or5flm22.speaker: Flem

or5flm24.dialogue: Hulu ulaa, leg-walkers! You go big stone place, you come out, we salute the leg-walkers, yes! Where you go now?
or5flm24.speaker: Flem

or5flm25.dialogue: Hulu, you walk well, you walk many places, where you walk now?
or5flm25.speaker: Flem

or5flm26.dialogue: Hulu, you back, tell Flem what place you been, yes.
or5flm26.speaker: Flem

or5flm27.dialogue: Dust, dirt, you smell of deep earth, yes. Where you been, leg-walkers?
or5flm27.speaker: Flem

or5flm28.dialogue: I know tales, tales from places, yes. What place you come from, O leg-walking people?
or5flm28.speaker: Flem

or5flm29.dialogue: You walk in earth, yes, earth speaks of places you been, blood you spill, yes.
or5flm29.speaker: Flem

or5flm30.dialogue: You return, you tell Flem place you been, yes?
or5flm30.speaker: Flem

or5flm31.dialogue: Huttu, see, your journey, dirt of your journey deep upon you, yes. Where you been, leg-walkers? Tell where dirt you wear comes from.
or5flm31.speaker: Flem

or5flm33.dialogue: Nolo, leg-walkers, uttu, I no speak, no tales for you now.
or5flm33.speaker: Flem

or5flm34.dialogue: Hulu, leg-people! Told you, yes, told you all tales already, no tales now, tales maybe later, yes.
or5flm34.speaker: Flem

or5flm35.dialogue: Hut, nolo, leg-people, no time for tales now.
or5flm35.speaker: Flem

or5flm36.dialogue: I have told you every tale I know.
or5flm36.speaker: Flem

or5flm40.dialogue: Hudbuba! You know of Sharpstick Ormyrrs? King chase them, they run away, they go deep in Dungeons, yes.
or5flm40.speaker: Flem

or5flm41.dialogue: Maybe you go, find Sharpstick Clan? They have things to trade, yes, good things for you.
or5flm41.speaker: Flem

or5flm42.dialogue: Nut, nolo, too bad you kill Sharpstick Ormyrrs. They good Ormyrrs, hated the Pujik so-called King.
or5flm42.speaker: Flem

or5flm43.dialogue: We Ormyrrs miss the Sharpstick clan, we grieve for our brothers and sisters of the mud.
or5flm43.speaker: Flem

or5flm45.dialogue: That place, Old Sweet Talk, he is Old Sweet Talk, down in that place.
or5flm45.speaker: Flem

or5flm46.dialogue: We trade, we trade necklaces with old sweet-talking one. Very carefully we trade with Old Sweet Talk. He has many treasures, yes.
or5flm46.speaker: Flem

or5flm52.dialogue: Hut, ulu, leg-walkers. In that place, Boulder-Man, Boulder-Man in that place.
or5flm52.speaker: Flem

or5flm53.dialogue: Strong as rock, squeaky voice, no one hurt the Boulder-Man.
or5flm53.speaker: Flem

or5flm54.dialogue: Down in Main Halls, you go see the Boulder-Man, be amazed, yes.
or5flm54.speaker: Flem

or5flm60.dialogue: Hutto, in that place, in dungeon place, now there is Deady Hole, many deady things come out of it, yes.
or5flm60.speaker: Flem

or5flm61.dialogue: Bad grebbo, the deady things, very bad grebbo, Ormyrrs stay far away from the Deady Hole.
or5flm61.speaker: Flem

or5flm65.dialogue: Deep, deep down in that place, the bad ones have a room, yes. They hide in room, Ormyrrs can't say magic, Ormyrrs can't get in to crush the bad ones...
or5flm65.speaker: Flem

or5flm66.dialogue: You find this room, yes? Dragon Claw put big mark in floor, Dragon symbol in floor, you find this symbol thing way down deep in the Dungeon place.
or5flm66.speaker: Flem

or5flm69.dialogue: Hut huttu, deep in dungeons, we hear about Ormyrr deep in Dungeons...
or5flm69.speaker: Flem

or5flm70.dialogue: Ormyrr is Geb, he look for magic thing, always seek magic thing for Ormyrrs, crazy Geb.
or5flm70.speaker: Flem

or5flm71.dialogue: Maybe you look for crazy Geb, down deep in Dungeon place?
or5flm71.speaker: Flem

or5flm72.dialogue: Nut, nolo, you kill Ormyrr deep in Dungeons?
or5flm72.speaker: Flem

or5flm73.dialogue: This Ormyrr not bad Ormyrr, just crazy Ormyrr, Ormyrr who wants the magic thing for all Ormyrrs. Ormyrrs sad that you kill this good Ormyrr.
or5flm73.speaker: Flem

or5flm76.dialogue: Down in dungeon place, deep down, doors with claw sign, sign of bad ones, yes...
or5flm76.speaker: Flem

or5flm77.dialogue: Ormyrrs try and try, Ormyrrs use blood strength of the earth, but these doors not open, no, no, not for Ormyrrs.
or5flm77.speaker: Flem

or5flm78.dialogue: You meet Water Lady, leg-walkers? Water Lady sing, dance, Ormyrrs glad when Water Lady dance upon the waters.
or5flm78.speaker: Flem

or5flm79.dialogue: She ask, you find, you find music bells for Water Lady, down deep in dungeon place.
or5flm79.speaker: Flem

or5flm80.dialogue: Puttuk toko, leg-walking friends! Water Lady waits, waiting long time for music bells, why you give no music bells?
or5flm80.speaker: Flem

or5flm81.dialogue: Put music bells into well, huttu! So Water Lady dance again, so beautiful on the waters.
or5flm81.speaker: Flem

or5flm82.dialogue: We are hoping, Ormyrrs are hoping, you give all music bells to Water Lady.
or5flm82.speaker: Flem

or5flm83.dialogue: Water Lady dance for Ormyrrs, Ormyrrs all dance in water with the Lady of Watersong.
or5flm83.speaker: Flem

or5flm86.dialogue: In that place, Scrap-Man find bone in that place, powerful head bone, yes.
or5flm86.speaker: Flem

or5flm87.dialogue: But drows take bone from Scrap-Man, take it to their mistress, the Grey-Eyed One. Ormyrrs see all this, we tell you, help you, yes.
or5flm87.speaker: Flem

or5flm88.dialogue: Here is a story. Orogs come up from underground, from the Cat-a-combs, yes, to trade with Ormyrrs.
or5flm88.speaker: Flem

or5flm89.dialogue: Orogs want fish for their master, living fishes, yes. And Orogs say their master has a bright stone, white stone, white magic stone all locked up in a cage.
or5flm89.speaker: Flem

or5flm92.dialogue: You know this, Lord of that Place, the Deady Elf, you know the Deady Elf?
or5flm92.speaker: Flem

or5flm93.dialogue: Deady Elf way under ground, yes, deeper than deep places where Ormyrrs hardly go.
or5flm93.speaker: Flem

or5flm94.dialogue: You go that place, Cat-a-Comb place, you find the Deady Elf. Be ready, leg-walkers!
or5flm94.speaker: Flem

or5flm96.dialogue: Listen, you ones! Sneakly Ormyrrs see thing, interesting thing, down in that Cat-a-comb place...
or5flm96.speaker: Flem

or5flm97.dialogue: Dark elfs fight with dark elfs in the slippery halls. This is savage! Dark elf woman, crazy woman, she killing everyone...
or5flm97.speaker: Flem

or5flm98.dialogue: Then bad ones come with the Bright Stick, all the dark elfs are running, the dark elf woman run away. This interesting thing the sneakly Ormyrrs saw, and huffpuff come to tell me.
or5flm98.speaker: Flem

or5flma0.dialogue: Hut, hulu, Ormyrrs try to get the Bright Stick for our friends the leg-walkers.
or5flma0.speaker: Flem

or5flma1.dialogue: Down in Cat-a-combs, bad ones hold the Bright Stick, use against dark elfs, yes.
or5flma1.speaker: Flem

or5flma2.dialogue: But Ormyrrs all die, too bad, magic kill all Ormyrrs who try to get Bright Stick.
or5flma2.speaker: Flem

or5flma8.dialogue: Listen, leg-walkers, you teetery insect people. I tell of stone houses, great stone houses of this place, up on hill.
or5flma8.speaker: Flem

or5flma9.dialogue: Little House is Dwarf-House, thick walls, yes, on Dwarf House north of here.
or5flma9.speaker: Flem

or5flmb0.dialogue: Dragon House is Magic House. Ormyrrs don't know magic, we lost the magic thing. So Ormyrrs never go to Dragon House, except sometimes.
or5flmb0.speaker: Flem

or5flmb1.dialogue: Big House on hill, Castle House, Big Stone House. Ormyrrs used to take care of Big House, but no more, very hard now, very hard to get into Big Castle House.
or5flmb1.speaker: Flem

or5flmb4.dialogue: Oho, leg-walkers, you brave, you very brave to think you go to Big Stone Place.
or5flmb4.speaker: Flem

or5flmb5.dialogue: Ormyrrs go there, sneaky Ormyrrs get in, yes. But Ormyrrs are strong!
or5flmb5.speaker: Flem

or5flmb7.dialogue: One Ormyrr, sneaky Ormyrr, she go to Big Stone Place. See terrible things, yes!
or5flmb7.speaker: Flem

or5flmb8.dialogue: People shrieking, souls shrieking, put into big jar, bodies all stiff and undeadly, oh yes.
or5flmb8.speaker: Flem

or5flmc0.dialogue: This Ormyrr, skinny Ormyrr, he slip into Big Stone Place. But trap there, dwarfs leave trap, old trap, so this skinny Ormyrr, he come back.
or5flmc0.speaker: Flem

or5flmc1.dialogue: So you, leg-walkers, watch out for old traps in Big Stone Place. Make traps snap on bad ones, yes yes!
or5flmc1.speaker: Flem

or5flmc3.dialogue: Twig-leg friends! Ormyrr see the great dragon leave the Big Stone Place!
or5flmc3.speaker: Flem

or5flmc4.dialogue: Twinkle gate open, yes, and it soar to the north, yes, and many little dragon ones gnatty after it, yes yes. To the north.
or5flmc4.speaker: Flem

or5flmc6.dialogue: Twig-legs! Ormyrrs see the great dragon return to Big Stone Place.
or5flmc6.speaker: Flem

or5flmc7.dialogue: It come from south, many little dragon ones follow it, yes, and Ormyrrs all hide! It come to Castle Place, and Twinkle Gate open, it disappears in the Twinkle Gate.
or5flmc7.speaker: Flem

or5flmc9.dialogue: Leg-walkers! Be careful! Ormyrrs see big dragon come out of Stone Place, coming low, hunting here, there, everywhere.
or5flmc9.speaker: Flem

or5flmd0.dialogue: Walk with care! Dragon hunt everywhere for enemies of the bad ones. When he find, he destroy.
or5flmd0.speaker: Flem

or5flmd3.dialogue: Leg-walkers, Ormyrrs catch some of the bad ones, we kill the leg-creepy bad ones over near the Dwarf House.
or5flmd3.speaker: Flem

or5flmd4.dialogue: Now listen, because one of the bad ones, he cry out, he yell things before we kill him.
or5flmd4.speaker: Flem

or5flmd5.dialogue: 'Mistress take you!' he yell out. 'Come up out of deep cavern beneath the Castle! Fry your bones! Mistress invincible because of Mythal!' This he cry out before we crush his head crick-klook into the earth.
or5flmd5.speaker: Flem

or5flmd8.dialogue: Hut, uttu, leg-walkers - in that place, Little Stone Place, you hear thum-bump of Splashing Heart?
or5flmd8.speaker: Flem

or5flmd9.dialogue: Something wrong with Splashing Heart in Little Stone Place. Black water make the Heart tired, yes.
or5flmd9.speaker: Flem

or5flme2.dialogue: Here is a thing. Ormyrrs meet Orogs, up in Dwarf House, yes.
or5flme2.speaker: Flem

or5flme3.dialogue: Orogs say, 'help us get Helm Cleaver thing.' Thing hold by bad ones, this is what the Orogs say to us.
or5flme3.speaker: Flem

or5flme4.dialogue: Ormyrrs say no, bad ones too much magic, too much bad magic for Ormyrrs. Maybe you help orogs, orogs in Dwarf House, yes.
or5flme4.speaker: Flem

or5flme5.dialogue: Here is a thing. Ormyrrs see orog ones attacking the bad ones, yes.
or5flme5.speaker: Flem

or5flme6.dialogue: Orog ones shout, 'Helm Cleaver! Helm Cleaver!' But bad ones magic, too much magic, too much bad magic to kill Orog ones down in dungeon place.
or5flme6.speaker: Flem

or5flme7.dialogue: Here is a thing. Ormyrrs meet Orogs down in dungeon place, big claw before doors, yes.
or5flme7.speaker: Flem

or5flme8.dialogue: Do you go, have you go to Dwarf House to the north? Water Lady come there, but no more Water Lady, because water so black and bad.
or5flme8.speaker: Flem

or5flmf1.dialogue: Hut-huttu, leg-walkers, why you not go to Golden Serpent, she who live in center of hill?
or5flmf1.speaker: Flem

or5flmf2.dialogue: Serpent in trouble, yes, orcs cause great Wind Serpent some trouble. Ormyrrs cannot help - orcs bad grebbo for Ormyrrs, nut nolo, very bad grebbo!
or5flmf2.speaker: Flem

or5flmf3.dialogue: You go, help Serpent in center of hill, yes, yes yes?
or5flmf3.speaker: Flem

or5flmf5.dialogue: Huttu, leg-walkers! Listen, here is a sad story, very sad.
or5flmf5.speaker: Flem

or5flmf6.dialogue: Ormyrrs have two pretty stones, magic stones. Pujik take one, green one, yes? But one Ormyrr run away with other, not give to so-called King, no no.
or5flmf6.speaker: Flem

or5flmf7.dialogue: But gargoyles come! Ormyrr all alone, gargoyles kill this Ormyrr all alone, take red stone, yes. Big gargoyle take red stone away from Ormyrrs.
or5flmf7.speaker: Flem

or5flmg2.dialogue: You find the cold one, yes? To the north, the cold one, warrior all cold of stone.
or5flmg2.speaker: Flem

or5flmg3.dialogue: Ormyrrs not go near the cold one, he is bad grebbo, cold magic on the sad man of stone.
or5flmg3.speaker: Flem

or5flmg5.dialogue: Hulu, walking ones, you find the Talk Mouth, you talk with batwing flappers?
or5flmg5.speaker: Flem

or5flmg6.dialogue: Talk Mouth underground, yes, underground near the House of Dwarf.
or5flmg6.speaker: Flem

or5flmg7.dialogue: Find Talk Mouth, fool gargoyles, yes, you trapsy the cruel ones with Talk Mouth of stone.
or5flmg7.speaker: Flem

or5flmh0.dialogue: Holo, nolo, leg-walkers, there is a place, the thirsty place, watch out for the thirsty place, yes!
or5flmh0.speaker: Flem

or5flmh1.dialogue: Green it is, by the Dwarf House, but oh oh the earth is dark and whispery, yes! Creature live in the earth, thirsty creature, yes.
or5flmh1.speaker: Flem

or5flmh2.dialogue: Go there if you are hurt, or whispery, or chill from chill touches, yes. If you are healthy, stay away!
or5flmh2.speaker: Flem

or5flmh6.dialogue: In the Dragon House, leg-walkers, look into the Peek Water Bowl.
or5flmh6.speaker: Flem

or5flmh7.dialogue: It is magic, magic not good for Ormyrrs, but others say they see far away, hard things, yes, terrible important things of the heart all appearing in Peek Water Bowl, in Dragon House. You look!
or5flmh7.speaker: Flem

or5flmh9.dialogue: Leg-walkers? Do you know, have you seen, Sisters of the Silver Fire?
or5flmh9.speaker: Flem

or5flmi0.dialogue: Days ago, many days ago, twelve of the Sisters, come up through the Swamp, come into City, yes.
or5flmi0.speaker: Flem

or5flmi1.dialogue: In front of Dragon House, they kill bad ones, O yes! Kill then gone, gone down into Cat-a-combs, Ormyrrs no more see Sisters of the Silver Fire.
or5flmi1.speaker: Flem

or5flmi4.dialogue: In the ruins, to the west - take care, leg-walkers, in the ruins west of our village.
or5flmi4.speaker: Flem

or5flmi5.dialogue: Lizards there, yes, many lizards, and their father, yes, very mysterious, father of magic above the leg-walking lizards.
or5flmi5.speaker: Flem

or5flmi6.dialogue: His name Malgi Hi, we no like Malgi Hi, all Ormyrrs hate Malgi Hi, the bad father of lizards.
or5flmi6.speaker: Flem

or5flmi8.dialogue: Do you know, do you have, little stone heads, idol heads, yes?
or5flmi8.speaker: Flem

or5flmi9.dialogue: Do not throw away your little stone heads! Big stone head to the west, yes, big stone head is hungry for them. Eats them up, spits out magic ding-ding.
or5flmi9.speaker: Flem

or5flmj2.dialogue: Hup, huttuk, you look for magic, yes? There is magic thing, bright angry orange thing to the west...
or5flmj2.speaker: Flem

or5flmj3.dialogue: Lizards hold the thing, lizards make it see, orange eye angry look down on lizards as they do war on Ormyrrs.
or5flmj3.speaker: Flem

or5flmj6.dialogue: Leg-walking ones! You see Ormyrrs, bad Ormyrrs, mad Ormyrrs, the ones of Maalun?
or5flmj6.speaker: Flem

or5flmj7.dialogue: Watch out, these Ormyrrs, they are terrible Ormyrrs, very terrible to leg-walking ones.
or5flmj7.speaker: Flem

or5flmj8.dialogue: Hut holo! We hear you kill the mad Ormyrrs, the ones of Maalun!
or5flmj8.speaker: Flem

or5flmj9.dialogue: We thank you, these were bad Ormyrrs, we cast out of tribe the mad Ormyrrs of Maalun.
or5flmj9.speaker: Flem

or5flmk3.dialogue: Nut, nolo, no more tales for you about the dungeon place.
or5flmk3.speaker: Flem

or5flmk4.dialogue: No more, leg-walkers, no more stories from the Hill and so on.
or5flmk4.speaker: Flem

or5flmk5.dialogue: Nut, nolo, no more about the lowlands here where we live, leg-walkers.
or5flmk5.speaker: Flem

or5flmk6.dialogue: No, no more, not now, leg-walkers. Later maybe I tell you more about Cat-a-comb places.
or5flmk6.speaker: Flem

or5flmk7.dialogue: Nut, nolo, no more tales for you about the dungeon place.
or5flmk7.speaker: Flem

or5flmk8.dialogue: I am sorry, leg-walkers, stories, all stories told about City ruins.
or5flmk8.speaker: Flem

or5flmk9.dialogue: No, no more, I tell you no more about Cat-a-combs.
or5flmk9.speaker: Flem

or5flml0.dialogue: I stop now. I tell you more about Big Stone Place sometime maybe later.
or5flml0.speaker: Flem

or5flml1.dialogue: That, no more, that is all I can tell about Dungeon places.
or5flml1.speaker: Flem

or5flml2.dialogue: No more, I say no more about Ruin places, leg-walking ones.
or5flml2.speaker: Flem

or5flml3.dialogue: Hobbo hutkut, I have said all already about the Cat-a-comb places.
or5flml3.speaker: Flem

or5flml4.dialogue: Nut, nolo, no more, you go back, go back now to Big Stone Place.
or5flml4.speaker: Flem

or5flml5.dialogue: Nut, nolo, no more tales about dungeon places.
or5flml5.speaker: Flem

or5flml6.dialogue: That is all, leg-walkers, all tales told you already about Ruin places.
or5flml6.speaker: Flem

or5flml7.dialogue: Cat-a-combs, all tales told, no more tales for you about deep Cat-a-comb places.
or5flml7.speaker: Flem

or5flml8.dialogue: Nut, nolo, goodbye, leg-walkers. All tales talked now, Flem say no more for leg-walking friends.
or5flml8.speaker: Flem

or5flml9.dialogue: Guttu holo, leg-walkers! Until we talk again.
or5flml9.speaker: Flem

or5flmm4.dialogue: May the earth be strong in you, leg-walkers! Goodbye.
or5flmm4.speaker: Flem

or5omjYE.dialogue: Hulu, we go now, gather things to trade. Goodbye.
or5omjYE.speaker: Ormsamaj

or5omjYG.dialogue: We go now, gather things to trade. Here is potion I promised, to heal you.
or5omjYG.speaker: Ormsamaj

or5pro00.dialogue: Tell him you've been in dungeons
or5pro00.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro01.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro02.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro03.dialogue: Tell him you're going to the Catacombs
or5pro03.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro05.dialogue: Tell him you've been in dungeons
or5pro05.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro06.dialogue: Tell him you've been to City ruins
or5pro06.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro07.dialogue: Tell him you've been in the Catacombs
or5pro07.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro08.dialogue: Tell him you're going to Castle Cormanthor
or5pro08.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro10.dialogue: Tell him you've been in the dungeons
or5pro10.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro11.dialogue: Tell him you've been in the City ruins
or5pro11.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro12.dialogue: Tell him you've been in the Catacombs
or5pro12.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro13.dialogue: Tell him you're exploring Castle Cormanthor
or5pro13.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro16.dialogue: Ask him about the City Ruins
or5pro16.speaker: Protagonist

or5pro18.dialogue: Tell him you seek adventure anywhere
or5pro18.speaker: Protagonist

om1omg02.dialogue: Hulu, your weapons, put them down! I not seek harm, no harm for you.
om1omg02.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg04.dialogue: Hai, hai, you are brave! You talk to me, I am a lost one, that is bad grebbo! Very bad grebbo, to talk with one who has lost his clan.
om1omg04.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg05.dialogue: Hoy, hep, no no, do not talk about grebbo! Very bad grebbo, very very bad grebbo, to talk about grebbo.
om1omg05.speaker: Ormygeb

om5omr05.dialogue: Hai, you tell us, you talk King, why you talk with Ormyrr King?
om5omr05.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr07.dialogue: Hai, Pujik, King, he calls himself King. He is no King!
om5omr07.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr08.dialogue: He get axe, marvelous axe, he think important, he says King...
om5omr08.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr09.dialogue: ...we say no King, he throw us out, throw Sharpsticks out of tribe.
om5omr09.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr10.dialogue: Magic-woman, red robes, she come flash! and give him axe.
om5omr10.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr11.dialogue: Room way down, down deep in dungeon, orcs in room, Sharpstick Room, grebbo orcs - very bad luck to Ormyrrs.
om5omr11.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr12.dialogue: You kill orcs, we go live in room, then we trade with you, good things to trade when we are in Sharpstick Room.
om5omr12.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr14.dialogue: Glove-things that grippli make, and swords, and bows, yes, good bows from elf.
om5omr14.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr15.dialogue: Stick-leg things, yes, things you like, we trade gold for things.
om5omr15.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr17.dialogue: We lonely, yes, heart heavy, yes, go back up to marsh, we must return to tribe.
om5omr17.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr18.dialogue: They kill us, maybe, Ormyrr King kill us, but we must go.
om5omr18.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr20.dialogue: Oi, oi, mad ormyrrs, Throttlevine clan, very bad grebbo.
om5omr20.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr21.dialogue: They want magic, try to learn magic, bad book teach them magic, they say.
om5omr21.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr22.dialogue: Book make them mad, crazy-bad, they hide, they scream, they kill everything, very bad.
om5omr22.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr23.dialogue: Book burn, I myself burn book, scatter book ashes, book no more.
om5omr23.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr25.dialogue: Hai, sad, very sad that Ormyrrs die, but no bad thing on you.
om5omr25.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr26.dialogue: Book was bad thing, magic book, bad for ormyrrs to seek magic.
om5omr26.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr28.dialogue: King! King! No King, no more, not for ormyrrs, never never.
om5omr28.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr29.dialogue: Oi! Oi! This is news, good news, very good news!
om5omr29.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr30.dialogue: You clever, yes, you strong, to kill Pujik, so-called King.
om5omr30.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr31.dialogue: Oi! Oi! We go back now, Sharpsticks! We go home.
om5omr31.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr33.dialogue: You want trade, stick-legs? You trade, good prices!
om5omr33.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr34.dialogue: Nulu, you lie, you were seen, one of us saw you talk-talk with King.
om5omr34.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr35.dialogue: Hulu, you wise, King very strong, but ormyrrs not follow King, no, only a few.
om5omr35.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr36.dialogue: What you talk about, talk so long-long with Ormyrr King?
om5omr36.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr37.dialogue: But we know you say nothing, promise nothing to King.
om5omr37.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr38.dialogue: Hulu, you wise, King very strong, but ormyrrs not like King, no, only a few.
om5omr38.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr40.dialogue: Now we tell true, heart-talk, friend to friend...
om5omr40.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr41.dialogue: ...Ormyrr King evil, he lies, do not trust Ormyrr King!
om5omr41.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr43.dialogue: Nulu, you lie, we heard, one of us heard you talk-talk with King.
om5omr43.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr44.dialogue: Speak! Speak! Or feel the points of our spears!
om5omr44.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr46.dialogue: We say speak, you tell us nothing! We should kill you! But heart say, wait.
om5omr46.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr47.dialogue: First you lie, now say nothing! We should kill you! But heart say, wait.
om5omr47.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr49.dialogue: Yes, yes, we trade, not so much good things anymore.
om5omr49.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr50.dialogue: Yes, yes, we trade, last time we trade, Ormyrrs go home.
om5omr50.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr51.dialogue: Goodbye, come back soon, we trade good things. Goodbye.
om5omr51.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr52.dialogue: Goodbye, we leave soon, go home, back to marsh. Goodbye.
om5omr52.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr53.dialogue: Goodbye, stick-legs, maybe someday we trade with you.
om5omr53.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr54.dialogue: You tell lies, too many lies, you come to kill us!
om5omr54.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr55.dialogue: Your silence speaks! It is true, you come to kill us!
om5omr55.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr57.dialogue: Look, we tired talk-talk, no more talk-talk.
om5omr57.speaker: Ormyreth

om6omj02.dialogue: Ah, good, you kill evil king, the usurper king, the Ormyrrs thank you.
om6omj02.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj03.dialogue: Hulu, now, do you trade, will you trade with Ormyrrs?
om6omj03.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj04.dialogue: We have many things, good things, good trade for you.
om6omj04.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj05.dialogue: We trade, many creatures, we trade with many creatures in the marsh. Grippli, yes, and nagas, yes, and sometimes dragon come.
om6omj05.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj06.dialogue: Dragon love gold, yes, we trade you things for gold.

om6omj08.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj09.dialogue: Ah, good, you come to me, you trade with Ormyrrs.
om6omj09.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj10.dialogue: You have gold? We have things, good things to trade for gold.
om6omj10.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj11.dialogue: Stick-legs! Stick-legs! Stick-legs come to trade.
om6omj11.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj12.dialogue: Trade, yes? More trade? Good things to trade with our stick-leg friends.
om6omj12.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj14.dialogue: Stick-legs! You attack Ormyrrs, friendly Ormyrrs, so I say no trade, no trade with bad stick-legs no more forever.
om6omj14.speaker: Ormsamaj

kukzuk02.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk02.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kukzuk03.dialogue: And that's why they locked me up, because I know, I know, but I can't, the words, I can't words.
kukzuk03.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk03.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kukzuk04.dialogue: No words like nagas, I don't know no nagas, I read a book about them.
kukzuk04.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk04.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kutdma00.speaker: DM

kutzut04.dialogue: 'This zombie evidently killed its master by accident - so it is insane. It has read many books, however; learn what it knows before you destroy it.'
kutzut04.speaker: PRoster

kutzut05.dialogue: 'Name: Athan. Phlanian. Known to associate with Elminster. Learn what he knows before you destroy him.'
kutzut05.speaker: PRoster

kutzut06.dialogue: 'Name: Emmeric. Phlanian. Whereabouts currently unknown; lost in transit. If found, learn what he knows before you destroy him.'
kutzut06.speaker: PRoster

kutzut07.dialogue: 'Name: Fohvrak. Probably one of the traitor Orogs. Learn what he knows before you bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut07.speaker: PRoster

kutzut08.dialogue: 'Name: unknown. One of the lizardfolk under the thrall of Malgi Hi. Learn what it knows about the sorcerer before you bring it to the Pool.'
kutzut08.speaker: PRoster

kutzut09.dialogue: 'Name: Arkhel Shaanal, Freth Drow. A Cult patrol was found slaughtered in the Catacombs, and he was nearby. Obtain a confession before you bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut09.speaker: PRoster

kutzut10.dialogue: 'Name: unknown. Found in the Catacombs - clearly a spy. Obtain a confession before you bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut10.speaker: PRoster

kutzut11.dialogue: 'Name: unknown. Drow of the House of Kilsek, who somehow escaped the Pool. Find out how, then bring him back to the Pool.'

kutzut13.speaker: PRoster

kuvdma05.dialogue: The ancient defenses of Castle Cormanthor come to life.
kuvdma05.speaker: DM

kuvdma06.dialogue: But they find no enemy to defend against, so they grow still once again.
kuvdma06.speaker: DM

kuidma03.dialogue: The stairs go climbing steeply up. A glimmer of sunlight filters down, along with a faint breeze wafting smells from the out-of-doors.
kuidma03.speaker: DM

xueDM00.dialogue: Here it is - the Pool of Radiance lies at your feet. It is quiet, but you immediately sense its enormous power.
xueDM00.speaker: DM

xueDM01.dialogue: It occurs to you that with this power, you could utterly destroy Kya Mordrayn and Pelendralaar.
xueDM01.speaker: DM

xueDM02.dialogue: The power of the Pool is great and ever growing. Once Kya and Pelendralaar are dust, you could continue to use the energy it channels...
xueDM02.speaker: DM

xueDM03.dialogue: ...to root out the cells and cadres of the Cult of the Dragon all over Faerun, for example, and end their evil forever.
xueDM03.speaker: DM

xueDM04.dialogue: You realize that when you gain control of the Pool, you could make Kya's lies to the Baelnorn into truth. With the Pool behind you, you could drive all the evil things out of Myth Drannor...
xueDM04.speaker: DM

xueDM05.dialogue: ...and make the city live again in glory. All Faerun would honor you!
xueDM05.speaker: DM

xueDM06.dialogue: Taking control of the Pool will be easy. Keeping control will be harder. Many in Faerun will seek to wrest its power from you...
xueDM06.speaker: DM

xueDM07.dialogue: But you realize it will be easy to fashion a trap for these fools. You can use the power of the Pool itself as bait. Mesmerized by it, your enemies will be easy prey...
xueDM07.speaker: DM

xueDM08.dialogue: You rouse yourself from your thoughts, as if from a deep slumber - to find you are not alone.
xueDM08.speaker: DM

xueDM09.dialogue: You brush aside the Pool's ensnaring spell, as a bear brushes aside cobwebs. You've escaped a cleverly laid trap!
xueDM09.speaker: DM

xuepro00.dialogue: Ponder that thought for a moment
xuepro00.speaker: Protagonist

xuepro02.dialogue: Think of other uses for the Pool's power
xuepro02.speaker: Protagonist

xuepro04.dialogue: Ponder how to control the Pool's power
xuepro04.speaker: Protagonist

kxdDM00.dialogue: With a whisper of footfalls the ghosts disappear, across the bridge that once stood here, into the warrens of Castle Cormanthor's deepest refuge.
kxdDM00.speaker: DM

kxdDM01.dialogue: But the ancient defenses failed, and the Army of Darkness invaded the refuge and collapsed its halls. Of the people who sought haven here, only the nameless ghosts remain.
kxdDM01.speaker: DM

kxcDM00.dialogue: The hundreds of ghosts are now thousands. With rising urgency they fling aside weapons and possessions, and press northward toward the illusion of safe haven.
kxcDM00.speaker: DM

kxeDM00.dialogue: You suddenly become aware of a presence. The spirit of an elf mage stands here, peering into the darkness of time.
kxeDM00.speaker: DM

kxeDM01.dialogue: She pays no notice to you or what you carry. She waits still for someone or something that may never come.
kxeDM01.speaker: DM

kxeDM02.dialogue: You become aware of a presence. The spirit of an elf mage stands here, peering into the darkness of time.
kxeDM02.speaker: DM

kxeDM03.dialogue: Suddenly she also becomes aware of you. 'The Stone!' she seems to say. 'The defenses. All is not lost.'
kxeDM03.speaker: DM

kxeDM04.dialogue: She turns and disappears to the west.
kxeDM04.speaker: DM

kxeDM05.dialogue: Again the spirit of an elf mage appears, peering into the darkness. But now she also perceives you and what you carry.
kxeDM05.speaker: DM

kxeDM06.dialogue: 'The Stone!' she says, wordlessly. 'The defenses. All is not lost.'
kxeDM06.speaker: DM

kxeDM07.dialogue: She turns and disappears to the west.
kxeDM07.speaker: DM

kxeDM08.dialogue: The ghost still stands here, intently waiting for something.
kxeDM08.speaker: DM

kxbDM00.dialogue: Suddenly you feel the presence of ghosts - hundreds of them. The shades of men, women and children flow around you like a river. Murmuring in dismay, they hurry off to the north.
kxbDM00.speaker: DM

ba9dma00.dialogue: Kya Mordrayn's passing tears a hole in the web of spells protecting the Pool of Radiance.
ba9dma00.speaker: DM

ba9dma01.dialogue: That gives Anorrweyn Evensong a moment to wield the power of the Mythal.
ba9dma01.speaker: DM

pl1pli02.dialogue: Listen, O listen you mortals, you who washed away the poison, listen to the song of the waters.
pl1pli02.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli03.dialogue: Listen, O listen you mortals, you who washed away the poisonous Pool, listen to the song of the waters.
pl1pli03.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli04.dialogue: My name - my name - it would take you a year to say my name, and you would say it badly, and have to say it again. Call me Plinshree.
pl1pli04.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli05.dialogue: As to what I am - why, I am the spirit of this place. A naiad, as your kind call us. My soul smiled here out of the first rainfall, and I was ancient long before the first tree grew.
pl1pli05.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli06.dialogue: But listen - listen - are you listening to the song?
pl1pli06.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli07.dialogue: No, no! Do you not hear it? The song is off. Three of the waterbells are missing.
pl1pli07.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli08.dialogue: Ahh, I am laughing, you try not to hear the water song - yet it sings inside of you! Your mortal blood, sighing in your veins, makes the same song.
pl1pli08.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli09.dialogue: But do you not hear it? The song is off. Three of the waterbells are missing.
pl1pli09.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli10.dialogue: They are shapely things, made of bone and shell, and hollowed out by sand and sea.
pl1pli10.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli11.dialogue: In the air, they are silent. But put them in the water, and they sing!
pl1pli11.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli12.dialogue: Two the serpents took, and locked away behind the Sign of Water. The last the foulers took, the dragon-lovers, after they poisoned the water.
pl1pli12.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli13.dialogue: Then give it into a city well or fountain. Return any waterbell to the water, and it will ring! I will hear it, and come to reward you.
pl1pli13.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli14.dialogue: Then give them into a city well or fountain. Return the waterbells to the water, and I will reward you.
pl1pli14.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli15.dialogue: For I have treasures to trade for them, things given to my keeping in the dark time, when Fire boiled the waters and the city died.
pl1pli15.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli16.dialogue: Yes, it is - for people of your kind. For if the song of water falters, then what waits ahead for you? Thirst and sand, floods and drowning, blood turning to dust...
pl1pli16.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli17.dialogue: But I care not what happens to you, you who are here one moment, gone the next. I care about my song, that is all, that is enough.
pl1pli17.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli18.dialogue: I want the waterbells back! I have treasures to trade for them, things given to my keeping in the dark time, when Fire boiled the waters and the city died.
pl1pli18.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli19.dialogue: If you find one of the three, give it into a city well or fountain. Return it to the water, and it will ring! I will hear it, and come to reward you.
pl1pli19.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli21.dialogue: Because silence - even a moment of it - lasts a lifetime. And music - even a year of it lasts but a moment. The waterbells make a gift of the centuries.
pl1pli21.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli22.dialogue: Oh, I do not oppose them. Why would I bother? Puny mortals, they will be dust in a moment...
pl1pli22.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli23.dialogue: ...but even if they were creatures of living flame, or tall as mountains, eventually the rain would quench their fire, and water would tumble their bones down to the Sea.
pl1pli23.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli24.dialogue: Foolish mortals! You ask for your own downfall. One glimpse, and you will join those who sail the seas, seeking, seeking...
pl1pli24.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli25.dialogue: Seeking what? To become a creature of the water once again. To drown in my beauty.
pl1pli25.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli26.dialogue: Oh, they are such things as your kind seems to delight in - slivers of metal, and eggs of glass...
pl1pli26.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli27.dialogue: Though why you treasure such bitter and tasteless things is beyond my understanding. They seem as burdens to me, not worth the smallest part of a song.
pl1pli27.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli29.dialogue: Help? I will do more than that! I will defeat them!
pl1pli29.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli30.dialogue: For even if they be creatures of living flame, or tall as mountains, rain will quench their fire in time, and water will tumble their bones down to the Sea.
pl1pli30.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli33.dialogue: But enough of this! Before I stopped to talk, I swam, yes, and I sang, so beautifully that aah! my heart aches just to remember it.
pl1pli33.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli34.dialogue: Maybe you think I waste my time, you who think 'struggle, struggle.' But think on this: What evil can stand up to the Sea?
pl1pli34.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli35.dialogue: Mark my words, if you truly oppose evil, you will learn to swim and sing. Goodbye!
pl1pli35.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli36.dialogue: Ahhh, I am laughing, you are telling the wind to leave you alone, and the rain not to fall!
pl1pli36.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli37.dialogue: Yes, it is goodbye - for you and people of your kind. For if the song of water falters, then what is ahead for you? Thirst and sand, floods and drowning, blood turning to dust...
pl1pli37.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli38.dialogue: I care nothing for your kind - here one moment, gone the next. But I want the waterbells back. Find them and return them to the waters, and I may reward you.
pl1pli38.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli39.dialogue: Otherwise, fear death by water! For evil and good, the mighty and the low - all you mortals are the same, once you enter the whirlpool.
pl1pli39.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli40.dialogue: Listen, now: in your travels you may find a waterbell, worthless to you maybe, if beauty counts for nothing.
pl1pli40.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli41.dialogue: Do not cast it aside! Give the waterbell unto the water, drop it into one of the city's wells! And maybe we will talk again about the music of the waters.
pl1pli41.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli42.dialogue: Then will I swim, yes, swim even more beautifully than before. I will swim so that the rocks weep and dissolve, and sing the songs that wash the hills and valleys, and make them be born anew.
pl1pli42.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli43.dialogue: This I do no matter what you do or say, but now you are a part of it, and this is noble beyond imagining for those of your kind. Goodbye.
pl1pli43.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli44.dialogue: And you can be part of this - just give the waterbell back to the water. Goodbye.
pl1pli44.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli45.dialogue: And you can be part of this - just give the waterbells back to the water. Goodbye.
pl1pli45.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli46.dialogue: Remember! Give the waterbells back to the water! Goodbye.
pl1pli46.speaker: plinshre

pl1pro01.dialogue: Ask who and what she is
pl1pro01.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro02.dialogue: Close your ears against the song
pl1pro02.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro03.dialogue: Tell her to leave you alone
pl1pro03.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro06.dialogue: Tell her you found a waterbell
pl1pro06.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro07.dialogue: Tell her you found her waterbells
pl1pro07.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro10.dialogue: Ask her why she needs the waterbells
pl1pro10.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro11.dialogue: Ask her about the treasures she has
pl1pro11.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro13.dialogue: Tell her you also oppose the 'dragon-lovers'
pl1pro13.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro14.dialogue: Ask her to help in your war with the Cult
pl1pro14.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro15.dialogue: Tell her you will try to find her waterbells
pl1pro15.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro16.dialogue: Tell her you will give her the waterbells
pl1pro16.speaker: Protagonist

pl2pli03.dialogue: O mortals, you who washed away the poisonous Pool of Radiance...
pl2pli03.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli04.dialogue: ...now try to win a victory more lasting! Restore the Splashing Song. Find the waterbells. Give them back to the water!
pl2pli04.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli04.desc: spoken, endlessly humored by the foolish pride of mortals

pl2pli05.dialogue: For even now evil creeps into the places you thought were clean. But the Song, ah, the Song of Water runs on and on and on.
pl2pli05.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli06.dialogue: Oyaa, the Pool is gone, the poisonous Pool, dissolved and washed away!
pl2pli06.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli07.dialogue: And they who stole the Waterbells, you have pitched them into the whirlpool, oyaa!
pl2pli07.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli08.dialogue: They will return - evil always returns. But always will heroes and deep water await them. And when they hear the Splashing Song, they will know their doom.
pl2pli08.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli09.dialogue: Oh! And I have been to the deepest places, and found another thing that may be of use to your kind. Farewell!
pl2pli09.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli13.dialogue: O mortals, you who washed away the poisonous Pool of Radiance...
pl2pli13.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli14.dialogue: ...dwell not overlong on your brief victory. Evil dies, but it is never dead. Even now, behind your back, the shadows grow long.
pl2pli14.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli15.dialogue: Do you desire an achievement that will last down the centuries? Then restore the Splashing Song. Give the waterbells back to the water!
pl2pli15.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli16.dialogue: Ahhh! This is E'lenthe, whom the waves carved from whalebone. Ah! I dance to have her back! Already it is if she had never been silent.
pl2pli16.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli17.dialogue: Oyaa! You have found Shihuala! Listen!
pl2pli17.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli17.desc: spoken, delight and amazement -oyaa! is a shout of joy, sfx of beautiful bell tone

pl2pli18.dialogue: This is the note that brings sun from rain, that makes pools glow with light and turns air crisp with joy.
pl2pli18.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli19.dialogue: This is best of all, Jawhimishan - the Waterbell of Endless Music. O Jawhimishan, how I have missed you!
pl2pli19.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli20.dialogue: In exchange, I have a gift for you. Have you found any of the other waterbells?
pl2pli20.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli21.dialogue: Here - I have for you another treasure, brought up from the deeps. Did you find the last missing waterbell? O that would be a marvel!
pl2pli21.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli23.dialogue: Ah, when last we met, you barely escaped the deep water...
pl2pli23.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli23.desc: spoken, warning you made her angry when you last spoke

pl2pli24.dialogue: But now you have brought me a waterbell! And see, my anger has ebbed - and in its place, a gift!
pl2pli24.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli26.dialogue: Aaah, I am laughing, you mortals are in such a hurry!
pl2pli26.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli27.dialogue: For certainly the waterbell would have come back to me in time.
pl2pli27.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli28.dialogue: But yet, I am happy to have it - and to get rid of this, which has no value to me.
pl2pli28.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli30.dialogue: You have made good your promise - and I have not forgotten mine!
pl2pli30.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli32.dialogue: You have made me happy. So here, I give you something you mortals seem to delight in...
pl2pli32.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli33.dialogue: You have given back to the water one of its treasures...
pl2pli33.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli34.dialogue: And see! I have brought you one of the treasures given to me, a long blade of purest crystal...
pl2pli34.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli35.dialogue: Or no, I have it not. Oh well, no matter. Here is a shiny thing that may be useful to your kind.
pl2pli35.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli35.desc: spoken, flighty 'oops I guess I don't really have that, nevermind!'

pl2pli36.dialogue: You have restored the music to the waters, O mortals. I will swim ever more beautifully, and you will swim with me.
pl2pli36.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli37.dialogue: It is one of the things given into my care in the time of Fire, the dark time when the city died.
pl2pli37.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli38.dialogue: I have many such things to be rid of, if you should find more waterbells.
pl2pli38.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli39.dialogue: I know of what you speak, but I do not know, for I do not care, it matters none to me. But for your sake I will try to remember...
pl2pli39.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli40.dialogue: Down it goes, I think, from under the spires, and its tendrils touch the deep waters.
pl2pli40.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli41.dialogue: But the waters care not. Evil always plants the seeds for its own downfall. Each evil deed spawns a hero. The waters wait - we are good at waiting.
pl2pli41.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli42.dialogue: But I must swim, and you must struggle on, in the way of your kind. Here is a thing that may aid you - but first...
pl2pli42.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli43.dialogue: Receive this rare blessing: the waters of knowledge, shaken from a naiad's hand.
pl2pli43.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli45.dialogue: Yes - I must swim, and you must struggle on in the way of your kind. Here is a thing that may aid you - but first...
pl2pli45.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli48.dialogue: Aah, you are mortals. For a moment, I had forgotten.
pl2pli48.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli49.dialogue: Aah, but you are mortals! For a moment, I had forgotten.
pl2pli49.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli50.dialogue: Mortals - and yet a little more. For the water sings, and you are part of it now. What the water knows, you know - a little bit.
pl2pli50.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli51.dialogue: Now - I must swim, and you must struggle on in the way of your kind. Here is a thing that may aid you - but first...
pl2pli51.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli52.dialogue: Ah, spoken like the mortals you are. For a moment, I had forgotten.
pl2pli52.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli53.dialogue: You turn a blind eye to beauty, and grasp for things of death.
pl2pli53.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli54.dialogue: Very well, I have a reward for you. A woman gave this to me in the dark time, just before the flame engulfed her and her children...
pl2pli54.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli55.dialogue: Why did she not entrust herself and her children to the waters? I would have been grateful for the gift - and more merciful than the flames...
pl2pli55.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli56.dialogue: But no, she only gave me this. And now I give it to you.
pl2pli56.speaker: plinshre

pl2pro00.dialogue: Tell her you can't swim all that well
pl2pro00.speaker: Protagonist

pl2pro02.dialogue: Agree to swim with the naiad
pl2pro02.speaker: Protagonist

pl2pro03.dialogue: Ask her where the Pool of Radiance is
pl2pro03.speaker: Protagonist

kybDMYB.dialogue: This stone also flies away, toward the City Heights.
kybDMYB.speaker: DM
